issues.description: setuptools<82 cap leaks from CI workaround into core/setup.py runtime install_requires.
issues.detail: All three reviewers flag this as the central problem. The mmcv/pkg_resources issue is a build-time CI concern, but the pin in core/setup.py forces every downstream user of autogluon.core to accept a capped setuptools forever. Scope the cap to CI scripts only, or move it to the mmcv extra.

issues.description: mmdet silently bumped from 3.2.0 to 3.3.0 with no stated justification.
issues.detail: The PR is framed as a mmengine/setuptools fix, but a separate minor-version bump of mmdet rides along. No rationale is given for why 3.3.0 is required. Either justify it inline (e.g., required for mmengine 0.10.7 / mmcv 2.1.0 compatibility) or split it into its own commit so rollback is unambiguous.

issues.description: FIXME comments lack revert criteria and don't cover all three pin sites.
issues.detail: The shell-script FIXMEs reference mmcv#3325 but don't specify the condition that flips the cap off or who owns checking. The core/setup.py pin has no FIXME breadcrumb at all. Add the explicit revert trigger ("once mmcv ships a wheel that doesn't import pkg_resources at build time") and annotate every pin site.

issues.description: Switch from mim to pip --no-build-isolation is a semantic change without explanation.
issues.detail: mim resolved prebuilt wheels matched to torch/CUDA; pip --no-build-isolation forces a source build using the ambient setuptools<82 and assumes torch/ninja are preinstalled. This is the actual mechanism of the workaround. Add a one-line comment so the next maintainer understands the precondition and doesn't "clean up" back to mim.

synthesis.summary: The panel reaches strong consensus: the CI-side workaround (pin setuptools<82, install mmengine from PyPI) is a reasonable response to upstream mmcv issue 3325, but the patch does too many things at once. The headline problem, flagged by all three reviewers, is that the setuptools<82 cap leaks from CI into core/setup.py's install_requires — imposing a transient build constraint on every downstream user of autogluon.core. A silent mmdet 3.2.0 -> 3.3.0 bump rides along without justification and should be split or explained. The FIXMEs need explicit revert criteria, and the mim-to-pip --no-build-isolation switch is the actual mechanism of the fix and deserves an inline comment. Verdict: NEEDS-WORK — scope the pin to CI, split or justify the mmdet bump, and document the revert trigger.
